name: Moshi
description: Install moshi-hook and bridge its Unix socket in from the Docker host over SSH

version.description: Select or enter a moshi-hook version to install

bridge.description: Bridge the host's moshi-hook Unix socket into the container over SSH, so agent hooks running inside the container can reach the moshi-hook daemon on the host. Needed on Docker Desktop / OrbStack-style setups, where the host's Unix socket file isn't reachable through a bind mount. Requires Remote Login (sshd) enabled on the host and remoteUser set. Independent of the herdr feature — works with or without it installed.

remoteUser.description: The username to SSH into for the socket bridge. Leave empty to disable the bridge even if `bridge` is true.

remoteHost.description: Hostname of the Docker host, reachable from inside the container

remoteSocketPath.description: Absolute path of the moshi-hook Unix socket on the Docker host. Leave empty to default to /Users/<remoteUser>/Library/Application Support/Moshi/moshi-hook.sock (macOS's moshi-hook default). moshi-hook's default location isn't under $HOME on Linux hosts — set this explicitly there, typically $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/moshi-hook.sock or /tmp/moshi-hook.sock (check `moshi-hook status` on that host).

privateKeyPath.description: Path inside the container where a dedicated bridge SSH private key would be bind-mounted, IF you use one. Optional: if no file exists at this path when the container starts, ssh runs without -i and falls back to whatever auth is otherwise available (e.g. an agent forwarded via SSH_AUTH_SOCK). Re-checked on every reconnect attempt, not just once at container start.
